status: planned; no new GPU jobs submitted; expanded training manifest must be prepared and frozen before execution
purpose: Identify a cause of the latent-only pilot regression before changing architecture or adding another loss.

evidence.interpretation: The earlier pilots warm-started from EMA weights with a fresh optimizer; they did not resume the original training state. Comparisons between their matched arms remain valid. The beta difference alone has not been shown to cause regression.

screen.reuse_control_condition: Same initial EMA checkpoint, 500 updates, learning-rate schedule, EMA decay, precision, batch shapes, flow RNG, sampling and evaluator. Source and evaluation fingerprints must match; preserve previous default settings in the trainer.

arms.name: broader_training_pool
arms.only_change: Expand the training pool to 16384 proteins from the same cache sources, keeping bucket frequencies and update budget fixed
arms.data_preflight: Deterministic nested selection that contains the original 1024 records; train splits only; verify sequence, finite latent/embedding arrays and shapes; verify original records are unchanged. All sources must be covered by the frozen holdout exclusion audit. Freeze manifest before scoring. No new ESM embeddings or source-structure downloads.

screen.evaluation: All 626 reused development proteins, three fixed samples, 25 flow steps, CFG 2, strict FP32, fixed residue correspondence. No final-test evaluation.

resource_plan.basis: Prior 500-update latent-only runs including full scoring took approximately 37-38 minutes; broader-pool preparation is CPU work and must finish before GPU allocation.
resource_plan.monitoring: Register exact job IDs and a supported analysis action; check only this project's jobs. Follow all jobs through analysis.

followup.replicate_only_if: An arm improves mean TM over its matched control by at least 0.002 and reaches the untouched checkpoint's mean TM, with full coverage and passing numerical controls. This is a recovery screen, not an accuracy promotion rule.
followup.replication: Run only that arm for seeds 7920 and 7921 against the existing paired controls. If multiple arms qualify, select the largest TM gain; ties within 0.0005 prefer no additional data, then optimizer-beta correction.
followup.recovery_claim: Require positive paired gains in all three seeds and a sequence-cluster interval above zero versus continued-training controls; report comparison with the untouched checkpoint separately.
followup.accuracy_promotion: Unchanged: practical TM gain at least 0.01 plus the existing uncertainty, replication, lDDT and geometry gates, followed by independent confirmation.
followup.stop: Do not expand failed arms into a hyperparameter sweep or combine individually unhelpful changes. Audit the saved raw-model/optimizer resume path separately if recovery fails. Do not claim these three arms exhaust possible causes.
followup.final_test: Keep the locked 34 targets unscored. Only two are longer than 256 residues; long-chain confirmation needs better coverage.
